inputs.text: Calling this “fairness” disguises an exclusionary policy that pushes transgender women and DSD athletes out of the female category. Protecting women’s sport cannot mean treating vulnerable competitors as threats or denying them dignity. The deeper issue is who gets the power to define womanhood—and whether that power is exercised through transparent rules and due process or through institutions shutting people out.
